verdict.rationale: Obsidian has extensibility (plugins, templates, URI actions, headless Sync for automated workflows), so automation management is a fair question for this product. The evidence shows no first-party way to version, review, or roll back automations. Sync's version history restores previous versions of notes, not automations, and Git or other third-party sync is an external workaround, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
